title: AnalystOverride
description: Structured record of an analyst override decision on an RCA card. Persisted as a separate artifact to support regulatory audit trails and override-history mining for recurrence signals.

override_id.description: Unique identifier for this override record. Format: OVRD::{event_id}::{iso_timestamp}

run_id.description: RCA run_id this override was applied to.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the override was recorded.

analyst_id.description: Identifier of the analyst who made the override. Null if not provided.

override_type.description: Semantic classification of the override action. Used for aggregate mining of override patterns.

rationale.description: Analyst-provided free-text rationale for the override decision. Required for regulatory auditability.

original_primary.description: Snapshot of the RCA card's primary_hypothesis at the time of override. Preserved immutably for audit.

override_primary.description: Candidate selected by the analyst as new primary. Required when override_type is primary_candidate_change; null otherwise.

questions_resolved.description: Analyst responses to the questions_to_resolve listed in analyst_review. Each resolved question becomes part of the permanent override record.

evidence_additions.description: Evidence references the analyst added that were not in the original evidence_bundle. Each addition is stamped as analyst-provided for traceability.

evidence_ref.description: Document ID, snippet ID, or free-text reference to the added evidence.

writeback_decision.description: Analyst's final disposition: accept (proceed to writeback), reject (discard RCA), defer (hold pending further investigation).

caveats.description: Analyst-noted caveats that must accompany the RCA if written back to the plant information system.

provenance.description: Traceability back to the base RCA run.

base_rca_card_id.description: rca_id of the RCA card that was overridden.

generated_by.description: Module that produced this override record.

original_decision_status.description: executive_summary.decision_status of the original RCA card.

original_writeback_recommendation.description: analyst_review.writeback_recommendation of the original RCA card.
